fact_notes: Born July 7, 1981, Ranchi (then Bihar, now Jharkhand); father Pan Singh, pump operator at MECON: commonly cited (ESPNcricinfo, biographies).
School football goalkeeper moved to wicketkeeping by a coach: widely reported; coach name omitted.
Ticket collector (TTE) with South Eastern Railway at Kharagpur, c. 2001-2003: widely reported; years approximate.
ODI debut Dec 23, 2004 vs Bangladesh at Chattogram, run out for 0: ESPNcricinfo scorecard.
148 vs Pakistan, Visakhapatnam, April 2005 (about four months after debut); 183* vs Sri Lanka, Jaipur, Oct 31, 2005, then the highest score by a wicketkeeper in ODIs: ESPNcricinfo.
2007 World Twenty20, South Africa: India captained by Dhoni, beat Pakistan in the final by 5 runs (Sept 24, 2007, Johannesburg).
2011 World Cup final, Wankhede, April 2, 2011: India beat Sri Lanka by 6 wickets; Dhoni 91 not out, winning six over long-on; India's previous title 1983 (28 years).
2013 Champions Trophy won in England; Dhoni commonly cited as the only captain to win World Cup, World T20 and Champions Trophy.
Retired from international cricket Aug 15, 2020 via Instagram video.
350 ODIs, 10,773 runs: ESPNcricinfo career stats. Verify all against a live source before final.
